goal: Provide compact minimal patches for four independent audit repair packages: reports, warehouse validation, shared ID reservation and customer profile points.
design:
Correct top-selling base quantities, damaged-return XNT and inclusive calendar-day report boundaries.
In getTopBanChay aggregate ChiTietXuatLo by maChiTiet once and use SUM of that base quantity for product lines, ct.soLuong for services; avoid multiplying money by joins, retain ct.maSanPham/dichVu mapping and output DTO. XNT must use COALESCE(ct.soLuongCoSoHoan,0) for physical returned stock, not NULLIF fallback; 0 means damaged/no restock and is valid. ThongKeBus LocalDate overloads use denNgay.plusDays(1).atStartOfDay with existing exclusive DAO end. Also daily internal report methods use tomorrow start. This fixes DATE staff shift filter automatically. Do not silently change LocalDateTime overload end semantics.

Reserve incrementing business IDs safely across separate Java processes, not only within a JVM.
Add idempotent migration sql/20261108_MaTuSinhSequence.sql: dbo.MaTuSinhSequence(prefix NVARCHAR(80) PK,giaTri BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK>=0). No USE, DROP DATABASE, seed deletion or credentials. In MaTuSinhHelper replace numeric MAX/cache allocation for both generic and daily IDs with same-connection JDBC transaction SERIALIZABLE: SELECT giaTri with UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK by prefix; if absent initialize by MAX TRY_CONVERT existing entity suffix on that same connection; next=max+1; insert/update reserved value and commit before return. Rollback and close on any failure; if table absent throw clear IllegalStateException requesting migration, never silently fall back. Retry a SQL deadlock at most 3 times. Existing prefix/format/public signatures remain; gaps are acceptable and never reused. No int overflow: validate next<=Integer.MAX_VALUE. sinhMaTheSpaPass must use same reservation mechanism with PASS-phone- prefix and actual max suffix, replacing COUNT and silent error fallback. sinhMaPhanCong may keep temporary cache because actual DAO uses IDENTITY. DBConnection stays unchanged. Prefix/table/column are private internal constants, SQL values bound, not arbitrary user SQL.

Saving customer contact/profile must not overwrite loyalty points, even with stale client data or cashier role.
Add KhachHangDAO.updateProfile(KhachHang) which updates name/phone/email/address ONLY, preserving SQL diemTichLuy (include fallback legacy columns if existing DAO already supports). Generic BanHangBus.luuHoacCapNhatKhachHang overloads always use updateProfile for existing customer, ignore diemMoi; new profile starts at 0 points. Explicit capNhatThongTinKhachHang methods permit point edits ONLY when UserSession.isQuanLy; nonmanager profile saves use updateProfile and do not mutate cached points. KhachHangDAO.update (legacy method that writes points) must itself preserve points via updateProfile for nonmanagers, to prevent callers bypassing BUS. Update RAM only after SQL success; re-fetch persisted points or retain authoritative DB value, no stale write-back. Do not alter atomic increment/decrement used by POS. Preserve public signatures and manager manual adjustment capability.
